subject.title: fix: screen and camera capture continue after cancellation

question: Should the project accept a breaking public capture-handler delegate change for cancellation, or require an additive cancellation-aware API that preserves existing subscribers?
rationale: The patch changes public event contracts across camera and screen capabilities; preserving them is mechanically feasible, but accepting a breaking plugin/host contract is a maintainer API decision.

options.title: Preserve existing handlers
options.body: Retain the existing public events and introduce a separate cancellation-aware subscription path or adapter, then cover both paths with compatibility tests.

options.title: Accept the API break
options.body: Land the new delegate signatures only with explicit maintainer approval, documented upgrade guidance, and a versioning decision for external consumers.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing handlers
recommendation.body: Retain the existing public events and introduce a separate cancellation-aware subscription path or adapter, then cover both paths with compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent review covers the intended cancellation semantics and is the best available signal for routing the public-contract decision.
